text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: All right! Is everyone ready?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Everything right here! It's an 
all-you-can-take horse girl giveaway!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yay!!

Today, invited by Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, I 
came to a hospital along with her friends.

She had organized the academy's lost items 
entrusted to her by Symboli Rudolf, and 
decided to donate them to the children 
staying at the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you've got great taste! That's a 
Tracen Academy notebook!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you use it all the way to the end, 
maybe you'll become an amazing horse girl 
just like me~♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Toryaaah! I am your hated villain, 
Waruanwan!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, future PriFighters! Band together and 
take me down!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Eeeek~♪ Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm so glad. Everyone looks so 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's all thanks to you, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You told me before, didn't you? That what 
I did... would connect to the future.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The future means children! Pretty simple 
logic, huh?
choice_data_list: Is there a reason you chose the hospital?

Did you have a reason for picking the 
hospital?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...When I was really little, I was 
actually full of energy, believe it or 
not.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But at some point... even though I wanted 
to give it my all, my body just couldn't 
keep up with my feelings anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I ended up spending a lot of time visiting 
the hospital. There was a time when I was 
just like the kids here.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It really gets you down, you know? But 
back then, what gave me strength was—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A strong, cool Tracen Academy horse girl— 
That's right, President Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best so I can become like that 
someday too!" Thinking that gave me so 
much courage!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...I think having role models gives 
strength to these kids, too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Things used by the older girls at the 
academy will surely give everyone courage—

text_block_list.name: Small Child
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, this big sister's notebook... It 
says "I'll do my best!" ...Alright, I will 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ... Hehe, I'm so glad!
choice_data_list: Rudolf will surely be happy too.
Why don't you go join them?
You should go join in too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ... Hehe, I'm so glad!
choice_data_list: Rudolf will surely be happy too.
Why don't you go join them?
You should go join in too.

text_block_list.text:
Things that would have otherwise sat in 
storage are now bringing joy to these 
children... She'll definitely be thrilled 
to hear that.
choice_data_list:
We should report that the lost items found 
a new spark.

We have to report that the lost items got 
their shine back.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The lost items... found a new spark...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's it. That was it all along...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Whoaaaaaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, no...! It's, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, r-right! I have to go check if there's 
any left!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eh?
choice_data_list:
Aren't you also an older girl from Tracen 
Academy?

You're also an older sister from Tracen 
Academy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: Go have fun and play with all your energy.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Yes, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Alright! Tsuyoshi, heading out!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! Everyone! Tsuyoshi Monster is 
here!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: A monster?! Uh, umm, umm...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: RAAAWRRR!! ...Whoa, I got dizzy!!
